aspects.says: A participant decides in prepare and puts a response built from the request into the Context before it votes, so SendResponse answers on the abort path too.
basis: section:1.4 A Participant Decides in `prepare`, and an Abort Still Answers

aspects.says: Work that must happen only if the whole transaction succeeds belongs in commit, which never comes when a later participant aborts.
basis: section:1.4 A Participant Decides in `prepare`, and an Abort Still Answers

aspects.says: The TransactionManager's Context dump is turned into text before the masking listener sees it, so debug-context must be false.
basis: section:1.6 The Transaction Trace Dumps What the Log Filter Can't Mask

aspects.says: A component that fails in init or start leaves Q2 running with one warning and its file unrenamed; only a file Q2 can't read, build or configure becomes .BAD.
basis: section:1.3 A Component That Fails to Deploy Leaves Q2 Running, and Says So Once
section:1.3.1 Spot the Problem: The Package Rename

aspects.says: A request crosses QServer's channel, IncomingListener, a TransactionManager session and SendResponse; the channel's receive and send and the TransactionManager's event show which step dropped it.
basis: section:1.1 A Request Crosses Four Components, and the Log Shows Each Step

aspects.says: The TransactionManager creates each participant once and every session calls it, so per-transaction state lives in the Context, never in fields.
basis: section:1.5 One Participant Serves Every Session
section:1.5.1 Spot the Problem: The Terminal Check

aspects.says: The server runs from a jar whose main class is Q2, with lib/, deploy/, cfg/ and log/ beside it, and -E selects the environment file.
aspects.reason: packaging and the Q2 command line show themselves only in a deployed process, which a graded run doesn't start

aspects.says: The listener and the TransactionManager share only a queue name and a Space; a mismatch deploys cleanly and every request expires unread after the listener's timeout.
basis: section:1.2 The Listener and the TransactionManager Meet Only in a Queue
